title: Computer-assisted proof for mutually touching cylinders

creators.name: Matić, Ivan
creators.affiliation: Baruch College, City University of New York

creators.name: Radoičić, Radoš
creators.affiliation: Baruch College, City University of New York

description: Verifier for the paper 'Mutually touching cylinders: Littlewood's seven, and at most ten in general'. The program proves that no sign pattern on eleven points has properties (P1) and (P2), and no sign pattern on eight points has properties (P1)-(P4), as defined in the paper.
